attach_rule: Estimated cosmetic attachment points (source px): head_top is the highest opaque pixel near the anchor's x; eyes, neck and chest sit 17%, 33% and 47% of the way from there to the ground. Corrections go in attachment_overrides.json.
canvas_rule: Per form: the largest visible-bounds width and height across its 33 frames.
coordinates: Source image pixels; origin top-left; y down. Place a frame so its anchor sits on the character's ground point: Sprite2D with centered=false and offset = -anchor.

review_flag_meanings.airborne: Character is off the ground; a bottom anchor would pull him down to the floor.
review_flag_meanings.effect_heavy: Energy effects extend the visible bounds beyond the body.
review_flag_meanings.faint_fringe: Faint but visible pixels (alpha 8 up to the threshold) extend noticeably beyond the bounds: glow, shadow or haze.
review_flag_meanings.horizontal_sleep: Lying pose; must align to the sleeping mat, not the standing ground line.
review_flag_meanings.landscape_bounds: Visible content is wider than tall.
review_flag_meanings.touches_edge: Visible content reaches the image edge; art may be cropped.
review_flag_meanings.wardrobe: Wardrobe pose; framing may differ from gameplay frames.
review_flag_meanings.weak_alignment: Silhouette overlap with its reference frame is low (pose or drawing scale differs); check for jitter.

stable_anchor_rule: anchor shifted sideways so each frame's silhouette best overlaps its category's first frame (and that frame the idle_neutral frame). Use stable_anchor for animation; y is unchanged.
threshold_note: Visible bounds are stable for alpha thresholds 8-64 across the sampled frames; alpha 1-7 is invisible noise and is ignored.
